description: This file defines the OpenMeterLogger class for logging success events to the OpenMeter API, including environment validation, request preparation, and both synchronous and asynchronous logging methods.

classes.name: OpenMeterLogger
classes.description: A logger class for sending success event data to the OpenMeter API, extending CustomLogger with methods for environment validation and event logging.

methods.name: get_utc_datetime
methods.description: Returns the current UTC datetime, using datetime.now(dt.UTC) if available, otherwise datetime.utcnow().

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes an OpenMeterLogger instance, validating environment and setting up HTTP handlers.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Checks for required environment variables OPENMETER_API_ENDPOINT and OPENMETER_API_KEY.

methods.name: _common_logic
methods.description: Prepares the event data payload with metadata, user info, model, cost, and usage details.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Sends a success event to OpenMeter synchronously via HTTP POST.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a success event to OpenMeter via HTTP POST.
